'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[Italian Navy|Italian]] and [[Spanish Navy|Spanish navies]] deploy [[frigate]]s to assist and protect the [[Global Sumud Flotilla]] on its way to attempt to break the [[Israeli Defence Forces|Israeli]] [[blockade]] of the [[Gaza Strip]] after it was allegedly attacked by Israeli [[drone warfare|drones]] off the coast of [[Greece]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-flotilla-activists-5e7e0e22b2813f00a0b907fae84f9284 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/italy-sends-second-navy-ship-escort-gaza-aid-flotilla-2025-09-25/ (Reuters)]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least 57 [[Palestinians]], including 10 children and three women, are killed by [[Israel]]i airstrikes across the Gaza Strip. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-unga-macron-09-25-2025-a92c883b97b73a2d81e064c9d12589f1 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/25/live-israel-bombs-family-home-in-gaza-with-children-among-11-killed (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
****Two [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] militants are shot and killed by Israeli soldiers during the siege of a house in [[Tammun]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/25/live-israel-bombs-family-home-in-gaza-with-children-among-11-killed?update=3981285 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[September 2025 Israeli attacks in Yemen]]
****In response to a [[Drone warfare|drone]] attack the previous day that injured 50 [[Israelis|Israeli]] civilians, the [[Israeli Air Force]] bombs [[Houthis|Houthi]] targets in the [[Yemen]]i capital city of [[Sanaa]]. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2025/09/israel-strikes-yemens-sanaa-day-after-eilat-drone-attack-houthi-run-tv-says (Al Monitor)] 
****The [[Houthis]] launch a [[ballistic missile]] at [[central Israel]], which is intercepted. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-houthi-missile-intercepted-no-reports-of-injuries-or-damage/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/h17rszq2xx (YNet)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Tattooing in South Korea]]
**[[South Korea]]'s [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] passes a [[Law of South Korea|law]] legalizing [[tattoo artist]]ry by licensed non-medical professionals for the first time since a 1992 [[Supreme Court of Korea|court]] ruling restricted [[Medical tattoo|the practice to doctors]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp8jz0vrrp4o (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China–United States relations]], [[China–United States trade war]]
**[[China]] lists six [[United States|American]] companies on its [[Unreliable Entities List]], including several in the [[Unmanned underwater vehicle|underwater drone]] and [[space industry|satellite]] sectors. [https://apnews.com/article/china-us-trade-sanctions-a76e4e0890e126dd77d56dc4b17dddbe (AP)]
*[[Ethiopia–Russia relations]]
**[[Ethiopia]] and [[Russia]] sign an agreement on the construction of a nuclear power plant for [[Ethiopian Electric Power]] by [[Rosatom]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/russia-ethiopia-sign-action-plan-on-nuclear-power-project/3699303 (AA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed after a bus collides with a truck head-on in [[Sundergarh]], [[Odisha]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehansindia.com/news/national/six-die-in-bus-truck-crash-in-sundargarh-1009674 (''The Hans India'')]
*Decomposed bodies of five suspected [[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling|migrants]] are discovered in the [[Great Sand Sea]] south of [[Tobruk]], [[Libya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/libya-migrant-desert-death-remains-1279b00dc52a0dc509e3c78b03af942b (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of the Netherlands]], [[Foreign relations of Uganda]]
**The [[Netherlands]] and [[Uganda]] sign an agreement to establish a pilot [[transit hub]] in Uganda for rejected [[asylum seeker]]s from nearby countries who cannot be directly returned from the Netherlands. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/netherlands-uganda-sign-letter-intent-return-hub-deal-rejected-asylum-seekers-2025-09-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Iran relations]]
**[[France]] withdraws its case at the [[International Court of Justice]] accusing [[Iran]] of denying [[consular protection]] to two [[French people|French citizens]] [[List of foreign nationals detained in Iran|detained]] at [[Evin Prison]] in [[Tehran]] for more than three years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/france-drops-world-court-case-against-iran-over-detained-citizens-2025-09-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Mali relations]], [[French military withdrawal from West Africa (2022–present)|French military withdrawal from West Africa]]
**The [[Mali]]an [[Government of Mali|junta]] declares an end to joint [[counterterrorism]] operations with the [[French military]] and expels five [[Diplomatic missions of France|French embassy]] workers from the country, declaring them ''[[Persona non grata|personae non gratae]]''. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-france-intelligence-services-diplomacy-embassy-d5540b8380dc37eb40699cbf61f66ec0 (AP)]
*[[Israel–Slovenia relations]], [[International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli leaders]]
**The [[Slovenia]]n [[Government of Slovenia|government]] formally bans [[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] from entering the country, linking the ban to the [[International Criminal Court]] [[arrest warrant]] out for Netanyahu. [https://apnews.com/article/slovenia-israel-travel-ban-benjamin-32f77e2f2657fbfd82af7a2b632f2cc0 (AP)]
*[[Moldova–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] bars [[Moldovans|Moldovan]] politician [[Irina Vlah]] from entering its territory for five years for allegedly assisting [[Russia]]n interference in [[Moldova]]'s upcoming [[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election|parliamentary election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/poland-bans-pro-russian-moldovan-politician-irina-vlah-territory-2025-09-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]]
**Unrest erupts in [[Antananarivo]], [[Madagascar]], following power and water cuts in the capital city. [[Law enforcement in Madagascar|Security forces]] impose an evening [[curfew]]. [https://apnews.com/article/madagascar-protests-curfew-electricity-water-0225f744e674220649fc5a0520cdfcfd (AP)]
*[[Alleged Libyan financing in the 2007 French presidential election]]
**Former [[France|French]] [[President of France|president]] [[Nicolas Sarkozy]] is sentenced to 5 years in prison for criminal association, becoming the first former French president to be sentenced to prison. His former [[Minister of the Interior (France)|interior ministers]] [[Brice Hortefeux]] and [[Claude Guéant]] are sentenced to two years and six years of house arrest under [[electronic tagging]] respectively, due to a French law allowing prison sentences equal or inferior to 2 years to be converted in another sentences, and to Guéant's health issues. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp98kepmj9lo (BBC News)] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250925-france-s-sarkozy-set-to-learn-fate-in-libya-case (France 24)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**At least 17 people are killed in a [[prison riot]] in [[Esmeraldas, Ecuador|Esmeraldas]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-prison-riot-leaves-least-17-dead-2025-09-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines]]
**The [[Philippine]] [[Department of Justice (Philippines)|Department of Justice]] and the [[National Bureau of Investigation (Philippines)|National Bureau of Investigation]] file criminal [[Graft (politics)|graft]] and [[malversation]] charges against [[Senate of the Philippines|Senator]] [[Chiz Escudero]], former senator [[Nancy Binay]], and former [[Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Philippines|house speaker]] [[Martin Romualdez]] in connection with investigations into alleged [[Corruption in the Philippines|corruption]] in [[flood control]] projects. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2025/09/25/2475386/nbi-seeks-malversation-raps-escudero-binay-romualdez (''The Philippine Star'')]
*Two teenagers are killed and three others are injured and hospitalized in a [[school shooting]] in [[Sobral, Ceará|Sobral]], [[Ceará]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250925-two-teens-killed-in-shooting-at-brazil-school (AFP via France 24)] [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-school-fatal-shooting-ceara-sobral-49424502f7b84fc7ceba27ef93e5754a (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Lithuania]]'s [[Seimas|parliament]] votes 80–42 to approve a [[coalition government]] led by the [[Social Democratic Party of Lithuania|Social Democratic Party]], installing [[Inga Ruginienė]] as the new [[Prime Minister of Lithuania|prime minister]].
